findings.entity: man's mirror reflection vs real man
findings.description: The real man stands at the far left of frame close to the camera, angled toward the mirror, yet his reflection appears far to the right of center in the mirror (~x=950 vs real head ~x=200), nearly frontal to the camera with both shoulders squared. For a near-frontoparallel mirror and a camera directly behind his shoulder, the reflection should appear close to (and partly hidden behind) his own head and be seen at an oblique three-quarter angle matching his body orientation. The reflection behaves like a separate person facing the camera rather than a geometrically consistent mirror image; this persists for the entire clip.
